name: comp-149
title: Weekday Picker Checkboxes
description: Seven circular toggles, one per weekday, each showing its first letter. Tapping a circle fills it solid white; the last circle is permanently dimmed and does not respond.
use: A schedule or availability form needs a compact row for choosing which weekdays apply.
avoid: Four days start ticked and Sunday is permanently disabled, with the start state hardcoded.
a11y: Hidden full day names back the single letters and the row rings on focus, but the colour transition ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Under a small "Days of the week" heading, seven equal circles line up on a near-black stage. Chosen days are solid white with dark letters, untouched ones are dark with a thin outline, and the final circle is faded almost to the background.
behaves: Clicking a circle flips it between solid white and dark outline, so several days can be on at once; the final circle ignores clicks because it is disabled. Hover and keyboard focus ring the circle under the pointer.
customise: The days and their starting ticks come from an items array, while circle size and the disabled Sunday are fixed in the file.
weight: light: Seven small circles and hidden checkboxes with one colour transition.
